data.exact_reserve_text: The 2021 year of account is currently forecasting a breakeven return on capacity, which is predominantly due to prudent reserving.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 was GBP 14.774m. The report does not disclose an explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement figure. The Managing Agent notes that the 2021 year of account is forecasting a breakeven return, attributing this outcome predominantly to prudent reserving and modest premium growth/greater retention. No quantified gross prior-year development is provided in the technical provisions movement note; a gross claims development triangle is present but does not provide an explicit prior-year movement figure that can be unambiguously extracted for 2020 and earlier.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate experienced modest inwards premium growth across the life book during the year and purchased comparatively less facultative cover than in prior years, demonstrating the syndicate's appetite to retain the risks it writes.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found in the notes. The report contains narrative referencing prior-year outcomes (breakeven 2021 YOA due to 'prudent reserving') and a gross claims development table, but the parsed development table did not provide the prior-diagonal cumulative estimates in a form that allowed a reliable gross prior-year development calculation. Amounts in the financial statements are presented in 'GBP '000' and have been converted to millions (divide by 1,000). Prior-year development therefore returned as null rather than using a net figure.
